q: How do I calculate a fruit pack house's emissions per tonne packed?
title: Fruit pack house emissions per tonne
short: Add electricity for pre-cooling, washing, grading lines and cold rooms at 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, generator diesel and refrigerant top-ups, then divide by tonnes packed. Cartons and crates are bought-in packaging, added from supplier figures.
audience: Pack houses, fruit exporters and FPOs

p: Cartons, liners and crates are purchased goods. Add them per tonne packed from supplier figures for a fuller export footprint.
Divide by tonnes packed, and report by fruit and season, since grapes and pomegranates use cold storage very differently.

example.title: Worked example: export pack house (one month, illustrative inputs)
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use the pack house meter and dispatch records.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
